_doc: GNN model card: what the network is (task, inputs, normalisation, architecture, output) and how it is trained (training). python -m grand_gnn_train --gnn-model-card <this file> builds or reuses its dataset, trains, exports and evaluates it. See README.md and RUNBOOK_CC.md.
name: pgnn_energy_xy_cat5
description: pGNN energy with the same network as pgnn_direction_xy_cat5: EdgeCNN 5 x 256 with batch norm, jk cat (all layers concatenated), mean+max readout, 8 neighbours. Inputs, normalisation (gnn_lib), trigger and training as pgnn_energy_xy v1 (the GNN paper's recipe), so that only the network differs.
